200.description: The service is ready to receive traffic

503.description: Not ready, in one of two shapes. While the service is draining (shutdown in progress) the body is `{"status":"not_ready"}` with `Content-Type: application/json`. When Postgres or Kafka is not reachable the body is an RFC 7807 problem (`application/problem+json`, type `dependency-unavailable`, the detail names the failing dependencies).

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.
schema.title: ProblemDetails
